pattern: arithmetic across year-named columns, group sum, share
question: 2024 girls percentage of all enrolled children, per block
gold_sql: SELECT "Block", 100.0 * SUM("Girls 2024") / (SUM("Girls 2024") + SUM("Boys 2024")) AS girls_share_percent FROM school_enrolment_by_year GROUP BY "Block" ORDER BY "Block"
sql_duckdb: WITH block_totals AS (SELECT "Block", SUM("Girls 2024") AS total_girls_2024, SUM("Girls 2024" + "Boys 2024") AS total_enrolled_2024 FROM "school_enrolment_by_year" WHERE NOT "Girls 2024" IS NULL AND NOT "Boys 2024" IS NULL GROUP BY "Block") SELECT t."Block", (t.total_girls_2024 * 100.0 / NULLIF(NULLIF(t.total_enrolled_2024, 0), 0)) AS girls_percentage_2024 FROM block_totals AS t

WITH block_totals AS (
  SELECT
    "Block",
    SUM("Girls 2024") AS total_girls_2024,
    SUM("Girls 2024" + "Boys 2024") AS total_enrolled_2024
  FROM "school_enrolment_by_year"
  WHERE "Girls 2024" IS NOT NULL AND "Boys 2024" IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY "Block"
)
SELECT
  t."Block",
  (t.total_girls_2024 * 100.0 / NULLIF(t.total_enrolled_2024, 0)) AS girls_percentage_2024
FROM block_totals t;
